text:
Maya: Starting here — quick preflight for tonight's tiny schema bump (kv.record.meta + nullable field). Planning cross-svc pins: API, Runtime, Router, Console. Who's on for pin/rollback?
Sam: I'm on api/runtime. I'll handle API pin and smoke.
Aaron: Router + rollout gating from my side. Need to confirm header compatibility.
Jen: Console UI change is backward compatible but metrics tag name changes. I'll update release notes.
Maya: Plan: canary 1% traffic for 20m, then 10% for 30m, then ramp. Rollback if 5xx rate increases > 0.5% absolute or p99 latency +30% sustained 5m. ops-oncall: ack?
ops-oncall: ack. will monitor SLOs and swap to fallback if triggered.
Sam: Proposed pins: API -> v2.3.1-schema-bump, Runtime -> v1.9.0-quant (keeps kv layout), Router -> header-split-2026-03 (compat shim), Console -> v0.45.2.
Aaron: Router note: header-split branch requires a small route predicate change, will push compatible filter. No eviction changes.
Maya: deploy-bot, please create canary wave and pin the variants listed above. Include a manual hold step after 1% wave.
deploy-bot: @Maya received. Creating canary wave: 1% -> hold 20m -> 10% -> hold 30m -> ramp. Pins: API=v2.3.1-schema-bump, Runtime=v1.9.0-quant, Router=header-split-2026-03, Console=v0.45.2. Run ID: db-wave-7723459876.
Jen: Release notes draft: "kv.record.meta now nullable; Console telemetry tag renamed telemetry.v2. Backwards-compatible in API; runtime keeps legacy kv layout unless pinned to older runtime." I'll paste link: https://go/docs/releases/7723459876 (draft).
Sam: Smoke checklist for API: 
```
# smoke
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"text":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate
check p99 < baseline + 30% for 5m
check 200 responses for basic prompt set
```
Aaron: Router smoke: verify route predicate that inspects x-kv-meta header still passes. I will run the routing test script.
Maya: contingency: if deploy-bot can't pin a variant (resource conflict), fallback is to pin API+Router and keep runtime at previous canary-compatible variant, with runtime ops warming nodes.
ops-oncall: noted. Also set alerting thresholds: error-rate spike (5xx) above 0.5% -> pager. High p99 -> page if > +50%.
Sam: If we need rollback, sequence: 1) pause traffic, 2) pin all services back to previous stable tag, 3) clear cache/kv prefixes if corruption suspected, 4) open incident channel.
Maya: timeline: start at 02:00 UTC (change window). Preflight dry-run at 01:30 UTC (no traffic, just pin dry-run).
Jen: I'll push the release-note changelog and attach migration snippet in docs.
Aaron: I'll be ready to cut router rollbacks within 5m.
Sam: I'll stay on for smoke through first 40m.
Maya: Great. locking the plan. Anyone seeing missing dependencies?
Jen: One minor: analytics consumer uses telemetry.v2; I'll add toggle so old consumers won't break during canary.
Maya: Perfect. deploy-bot, kick when we hit 02:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Scheduling db-wave-7723459876 for 1700007200 (02:00 UTC). Will post updates in this thread during rollout. :rocket:
ops-oncall: I'll open the monitoring dashboard and keep a pinned view. Ping me if you want manual throttle.
Maya: Thanks team — postmortem template: small change, but we'll capture any regressions. If all green, I'll merge release notes after 04:00 UTC.
Sam: 👍
Aaron: 👍
Jen: 👍
